dom-2026-11-08.scena: An old brass telescope by an open Renaissance window at dusk, overlooking terracotta rooftops of a Tuscan town; Jupiter and its tiny moons glowing in a deep blue sky, a closed leather-bound book and a candle resting on the wooden sill.

dom-2026-11-15.scena: An old brass telescope by an open observatory dome at dawn, a vast starry sky with a faint glowing nebula fading into soft sunrise light, which illuminates the air and a wooden desk with closed notebooks and a small candle.

sab-2026-11-07.scena: A weathered wooden doorframe in a sunlit stone courtyard, a small plain brass mezuzah case fixed diagonally on the doorpost, warm evening light, potted olive tree, soft shadows on old Jerusalem limestone walls.

sab-2026-11-14.scena: A rustic clay bowl of steaming red lentil stew on a rough wooden table beside a tent opening, golden sunset over fertile hills of the ancient Near East, scattered lentil pods and a small oil lamp glowing softly

vetrina-prof.scena: A sunlit high school classroom at morning, empty wooden desks, a projector glowing softly, open notebooks and colorful folders on a teacher's desk, a window framing green hills and a distant bell tower, warm hopeful light.
